_comment: Saathi-shaped decisions, labelled by hand. Each case is a transcript as speech recognition would hand it over: lower-case, no punctuation to speak of, sometimes a filler word. The labels are what Saathi's own code would need to decide.

needs_screen.instructions: The person is talking to a voice companion on their Mac. Are they asking about something they can see on their screen right now — a window, a list, a button, a file, an error, a song in a list — such that the companion would have to look at the screen to answer?
positive: how do I play this song
which one of these is the settings
can you see what's on my screen
um what's that thing in the corner
what's the name of this song
how do I fill in this box
negative: how do I learn the tabla
set a timer for ten minutes
how do I say thank you in tamil
I want to learn how to edit video

manner.instructions: The companion asked how the person would like it to speak. Which of the three did they choose?

criteria.calm_and_slow: calm, slow, gentle, unhurried, softly, take your time, the first option
criteria.warm_and_normal: warm, friendly, normal, encouraging, cheerful, the middle option, the second option
criteria.plain: plain, direct, neutral, no fuss, just the facts, matter of fact, the last option, the third option

cases: um softly and not too fast
कदैसे ही आराम से और धीरे

language.instructions: The companion asked which language the person wants to talk in. Which did they choose?

criteria.none: they did not name a language, or named one not in this list
